verdict.rationale: Deel's founders page advertises a "98% approval rate", but the evidence says no basis is published alongside it: no case count, time window, or methodology. Deel's own blog says it has "processed thousands of visas across 50 countries", but that is a general volume claim and is not tied to the approval-rate figure. The 100% fee-refund guarantee is a related but different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
